result.title: [KR/EU][Story] Add Configurable Contact Information Section on PDP
result.description:
Background

The KR team would like to add a Contact Information section on the PDP.The contact information should be maintained from Magnolia CMS, instead of being hardcoded in frontend code.This section should support multilingual configuration and display the proper value based on the selected site language.

Reference:

  • The Homepage Footer already provides configurable fields in Magnolia for contact information and hyperlinks.

  • The PDP template currently retrieves product information from APIs, but this enhancement should add a separate configurable content area in the PDP template.

Requirement

Configurable Fields

Please add the following configurable fields in Magnolia:

Field
Description
Contact Title
Display title/label, e.g. 문의 / Contact
Email
Contact email address
Phone
Contact phone number

Multilingual Display Logic

The fields should support configuration by language.

Scenario 1 – Only one language is maintained

Example:

  • Korean Contact Title = 문의
  • English Contact Title = blank

Expected:

  • KO storefront → display 문의
  • EN storefront → also display 문의

If only one language value is maintained, the storefront should use that value as the fallback for all languages.

Scenario 2 – Both languages are maintained

Example:

  • Korean Contact Title = 문의
  • English Contact Title = Contact

Expected:

  • KO storefront → display 문의
  • EN storefront → display Contact

The same fallback logic should apply to Contact Title, Email, and Phone.

Frontend Display

Example:

문의: ASK@advantech.co.kr / 080-363-9494

The configured information should be displayed on PDP in the defined Contact Information area.

Example display:

Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/ccx4V5qJVv8uH0Qtg0CyxH/-Internal--IoTMart-UI-Design---Magnolia-?node-id=12956-10533&t=64JfgEM1QBcrBAn7-1

문의: ASK@advantech.co.kr / 080-363-9494


Magnolia Configuration

Please add configurable fields to the PDP template/component so the business team can maintain the Contact Information from Magnolia.

The implementation can refer to the existing Homepage Footer configuration, where contact information and links can be maintained from the Magnolia backend.

The configuration should be independent from the product API data.

cc @EricBA.Huang @YingHui.Yang (Matthew)
result.acceptance_criteria:
1. Magnolia provides configurable fields for Contact Title, Email, and Phone.
  2.  Each field supports Multi language configuration.
    1. If both KR and EN values are maintained, the storefront displays the value matching the selected language. (as well as EU language)
    2. If only one language value is maintained, the storefront uses that value as the fallback for both KR and EN.
  3.  Email can be displayed as a clickable email link.
  4.  Phone can be displayed as a clickable phone link where supported.
  5.  Business users can update the Contact Information from Magnolia without frontend code changes.
  6.  The Contact Information configuration is independent from the PDP product API data.
  7.  Existing PDP product information and functions remain unaffected.
